comparison.objective: Pour mixed coins from a jar and sort pennies and quarters into separate frames.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled bulk pouring followed by visual denomination classification and individual nonprehensile pushing of thin objects.
comparison.success_condition: Per-coin final-state credit for each penny or quarter wholly inside its designated frame; no spill, damage, release, or dwell requirement is specified.
comparison.reason: This is the closest generic sequence because both start by pouring a mixture and end with separated classes. Its tested separator is visual identity plus individual pushing, whereas the candidate tests physical aperture selection, orientation-dependent passage, bridge clearing, bimanual screen control, complete washer retention, and loss-sensitive recovery.
